description.value: Peter's Pasta is a family-owned Italian restaurant in downtown Kamloops, established in 1986 and now run by husband-and-wife team Barry and Nicole Persaud. The kitchen turns out fresh, house-made pasta paired with gourmet sauces and a rotating selection of local and regional craft beers. Cyclists can sit down for a full dine-in experience or grab a Take & Bake dinner to enjoy at camp.
